rule: any input class without a verifiable redistributable license or without per-item source attribution is trading_approved=false; trend signals derived from it may only flow into research workflows

inputClasses.license_status: no redistributable license; platform terms of service restrict scraping and redistribution
inputClasses.quantos_handling: reference only; production trend inputs must come from licensed providers via data.query.v1

example_platforms: per-publisher RSS feeds configured in config.yaml
inputClasses.license_status: per-publisher copyright; RSS access does not grant redistribution or derived-signal trading rights
inputClasses.quantos_handling: reference only; requires per-feed license review before any trading-adjacent use

example_platforms: openai-compatible endpoints configured by the operator
inputClasses.source_attribution: none for underlying training data; prompt and model version recorded by operator
inputClasses.license_status: provider terms govern output use; no provenance for embedded source claims
inputClasses.quantos_handling: rejected as a signal source; TP03 llmquant owns model provenance and diagnostics

inputClasses.upstream_surface: newsnow self-hosted instance configured via api_url
inputClasses.license_status: indeterminate; inherits the upstream platform restrictions of whatever the self-hosted instance scrapes
inputClasses.quantos_handling: rejected unless the operator supplies a per-source license manifest
